senses.gloss: (cmp. use of זָוַג Nithpa.) to come in (hostile) contact, to battle; with ל of person, to assist, battle for. Mekh. B’shall. 2 (ref. to Ex. XIV, 14) לא … יִלָּחֵם לכם אלא לעולם ילחם כנגדן וכ׳ not only this time will he assist you, but he will always battle against your enemies. Tanḥ. Masé 6 כשהלך להִלָּחֵם בישראל when he (Sisera) went to war against &c.
units: <cite ref="Exodus 14:14">Ib.</cite> Vayera 7 (ref. <he>בלחומו</he>, <cite ref="Job 20:23">Job XX, 23</cite>) <he>על המלחמות שהיו נִלְחָמִים עם וכ׳</he> for the battles which they fought against the Lord; a. fr.

senses.gloss: to contest, dispute. Y. M. Kat. III, 81ᵈ top אם חברים מִתְלַחֲמִים וכ׳ if scholars are at variance with one another, what concern is it to you? (B. Mets. 59ᵇ מנצחים זה את זה וכ׳).
